Reddit user "DabuSurvivor" compiled quite an impressive list of differences from the final version. I've copied it here:

  • Sunny Beach in general: the grate in front of the tunnel, a tortoise on top of that wall at the start (making that wall something you have to actually traverse), the wall being accessible right from the starting platform, bull's-eyes on the tortoises, I think there are only three chests on the wall rather than four in the final game?, different gem placements, it looks like the texture of the water's surface is different?

  • Different icon when you're spitting something out (red crosshairs instead of white circle - these crosshairs look pretty crappy so that's definitely a good change)

  • I think Spyro's face is fatter when he has something in his mouth here

  • Different font

  • I'm not sure whether the little dinos who have the bones give you spirit particles in the actual game? My first thought was that they didn't but now I think they do. Not 100% either way on this one, which I'm kicking myself for

  • Square buttons in Hurricos instead of circles

  • Massively different supercharge portals

  • Different sound when Spyro spits.

  • Possibly different sound when the large hatching dinos die? I also think the animation is different and they fall in place, rather than jumping and falling, in the final game, but I'm not sure.

  • No animation of the tree petting/calming down its beehive even when it makes the nurturing sort of sound

  • Different gem placements under the water in Sunny Beach

  • No turtle box at Sunny Beach

  • No flag by the start of Sunny Beach

  • Totally different spirit particle sound

  • Sparx looks... off somehow, but I'm not sure what it is. I don't know if his model is different or the animations or what, or maybe I'm just making it up because the quality doesn't let you see his glow or something.

  • No fish under the water at the start of Sunny Beach

  • You can only see Zoe for a really short amount of time at the very end, after Spyro resurfaces (is she at that point in the actual game? My memory says "yes she is, but she's to the right when you resurface, not to the left" but logic says no, because that's basically the beginning of the level and there are no enemies before her), but she looks very different - more like the many fairies of Spyro 1 than the Zoe of Spyro 2.

I don't think I'm missing any past that. What we can see of the post-surfacing room at the very end looks pretty much the same, which is interesting with how wildly different the rest of it was. I think the enemies who have inner tubes look a little more yellow, but that could just be a video, and I don't think there's a turtle crate dug into the wall like there ended up being (which would make sense with there not being one under the water), but it's only a few frames and it's very far in the background so I can't tell for sure."
